skills.delivery_notes: thrown shield that homes on the target, bounces/ricochets through multiple nearby enemies, then returns to the player ('hurl a magical aegis that will home in upon your target'; 'you throw a shield that bounces on monsters dealing massive damage to them'; 'ricochets to multiple nearby enemies, returns to player'). ricochet_bounce carries the bounce-through-pack identity; the RETURN-to-player leg is an out-and-return behavioral delta -> family-accrual candidate (docket). NO ailment named (fire theme never implies burn -- §0.1).

optional placed defensive zone ('one of the most strong defense skills but I did not choose it to be mobile'); dropped in the mobile variant. Not part of the core offensive loop in the mapped variant.

mapping_json.motion_frame: hurl the Aegis of Menhir shield to home on a target, ricochet through the pack, and boomerang back to the player, repeating on cooldown while staying mobile

economy: cooldown cadence on the throw cycle

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ricochet_bounce over chain: 'bounces on monsters' + 'ricochets to nearby enemies' is bounce-hop language, not target-arc. The 'returns to player' leg is the out-and-return SHAPE (basin-1 family) -> accrual candidate WITHOUT numbers; base ricochet_bounce does not encode the return, hence CLOSE + note. Element fire per elem_raw (Oathkeeper fire-shield base); Acid/Aether/Infernal-DOT variants exist but this kit's fetched identity is the fire base. GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_overkill approximates the multi-enemy hop payoff -- delivery-appropriate, not a hard capstone attestation. No status attestable.
